ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white mottling localized on the distal regions of both fluke lobes. Right lobe features a large, vertically oriented contiguous white patch; left lobe features smaller, fragmented white clusters. Central and medial regions are solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped depression at the central lobe junction.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge boundary, with more pronounced irregularities on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curvature sweeping upward toward sharp, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of small, high-contrast white circular spots on the outer-most edge of the right lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible within the white pigmentation zone on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged nicks along the trailing edge; white calcified clusters or heavy scarring on the right fluke tip.
